title: Debugging Basics
concept: Use io.println to print variable values and trace program execution — the simplest and most universal debugging technique.
why: Every programmer spends time debugging. Print-based debugging is the fastest way to understand what your program is actually doing.
tips: Print BEFORE and AFTER critical operations to see the change
Use descriptive labels so you know which print is which
Comment out debug prints when done — don't leave them in production
For complex state, print multiple values at key points
common_mistakes: Leaving debug prints in final code — clean them up!
Printing in a loop without limiting — thousands of lines of output
Not making print messages descriptive enough to identify the source
Using print debugging when you should be writing tests (later lesson!)
